harness.description: The AI harness to use for prompt execution.

mode.description: Whether prompts run in an interactive terminal or headless mode.

injectMode.description: When true, keeps the TUI alive between prompts and writes follow-up prompts directly into the PTY. Faster than restarting and avoids the Claude Code resume cache bug.

maxPromptTimeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a prompt to complete. Use -1 for unlimited.

scriptTimeout.description: Maximum time in seconds for end-condition scripts to run.

closeTerminalOnComplete.description: Automatically close the terminal when execution completes.

autoDeleteTempFiles.description: Automatically delete categorized prompt temp files after execution. Set to false to retain files in .flightpath/temp/ for debugging.

allowed.description: Explicitly allowed tools (used when permissionMode is 'custom').

denied.description: Explicitly denied tools (used when permissionMode is 'custom').

allowedDirs.description: Additional directories to allow tool access to. Applies to copilot-cli, claude-cli, codex-cli, and qwen-cli. Not supported by gemini-cli, opencode-cli, or copilot-chat.

copilotAllowAllPaths.description: Allow Copilot CLI to access all paths.

codexApprovalPolicy.description: Approval policy for Codex CLI tool calls.

defaultFormat.description: Default file format for new workflows.

defaultTemplate.description: Default template to use for new workflows.

defaultAgent.description: Default agent to use in new workflows.

defaultSkills.description: Default skills to include in new workflows.

resumeExistingSession.description: Resume an existing session when running a workflow.

priorContext.description: Prior context to inject before the first prompt.

autoLoadRecentSession.description: Automatically load the most recent session on startup.

omitAgentsSkillsOnResume.description: Omit agents/skills declarations when resuming an existing session.

oneOf.description: Default end condition applied to all new workflows. Individual prompts can override or disable this.

script.description: Shell command or script path to execute after each prompt.

returns.description: Expected result. For 'true'/'false' auto-mode uses exit code; others compare stdout.

compareSource.description: Which output to compare against returns.

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts. Use -1 for unlimited, 0 for none.

resumeSessionOnRetry.description: Resume the same session for retries (default: true).

oneOf.description: Disabled (default). New workflows have no end condition.
Default pre-condition gate applied to all new workflows. Individual prompts can override or disable this.

script.description: Shell command or script path to execute before each prompt.

returns.description: Expected result. For 'true'/'false' auto-mode uses exit code; others compare stdout.

compareSource.description: Which output to compare against returns.

oneOf.description: Disabled (default). New workflows have no pre-condition.

windowLocation.description: Where to open the Copilot Chat window.

inactivityTimeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before treating a chat session as complete.

treatTimeoutAsSuccess.description: Treat an inactivity timeout as a successful completion.

forceAgentMode.description: Force Copilot Chat into agent mode.

useNativeAttachments.description: Use native VS Code chat attachment API instead of inline text.

defaultServers.description: Default MCP servers to attach to each prompt execution.

hooks.description: User-defined hooks to run at various execution lifecycle points.

maxSize.description: Maximum number of prompts allowed in the queue.

maxWorkflowExecutionTime.description: Maximum total execution time in seconds for a workflow. Use -1 for unlimited.

unlimitedMode.description: Disable queue size and time limits.

notifyOnExtension.description: Show a notification when the queue is extended.

saveOutput.description: Save CLI output to execution history.

maxRuns.description: Maximum number of history entries to retain. Use -1 for unlimited.

scrollback.description: Maximum scrollback lines retained in memory.

macOptionIsMeta.description: Treat the macOS Option key as Meta.

wordSeparators.description: Characters treated as word boundaries on double-click selection.

replayBufferKb.description: Output replayed on webview reconnect, in KB.

shellExecutable.description: Override the shell spawned for user terminal sessions. Empty means auto-detect.

mobileControlBar.description: When to show the mobile terminal control bar.

mobileCustomShortcuts.description: Custom shortcuts in the mobile terminal control bar More menu.

showCliOutput.description: Show CLI output in the FlightPath panel.

showCliCommand.description: Show the CLI command being executed.

logRawCliOutput.description: Log raw CLI output to the extension output channel.

showHeadlessPermissionWarning.description: Show a warning when headless execution uses limited tool permissions.

autoFocusOutputOnExecution.description: Automatically expand the output section and switch to the relevant output view when a prompt starts. Headless runs show Output; interactive and inject-mode runs show Terminal.

openPromptsInSecondGroup.description: Open prompt files in a second editor group.

confirmDeleteOperations.description: Show a confirmation dialog before deleting prompts or workflow history.

confirmResetOperations.description: Show a confirmation dialog before resetting workflow start position.

showHiddenFiles.description: Show dotfiles and hidden directories in the workspace file explorer and workflow file picker.

enabled.description: Whether the FlightPath hosted server is enabled.

port.description: Port for the FlightPath hosted server.

standalonePort.description: Port for the standalone (non-extension) FlightPath server.

theme.description: Color theme for the hosted server UI.

bindAddress.description: Network interface to bind the server to. Use '127.0.0.1' for localhost only or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

tls.description: TLS configuration for the hosted server.

certPath.description: Path to the TLS certificate file.

keyPath.description: Path to the TLS private key file.

enabled.description: Show VS Code notification popups when workflows complete.

mode.description: When to send browser notifications. 'connectedOnly' fires while the hosted dashboard is open; 'push' enables background push notifications.

workflowComplete.description: When to notify on workflow completion.

promptComplete.description: When to notify on individual prompt completion.

includeWorkflowName.description: Include the workflow name in the notification message.

includePromptName.description: Include the prompt name in the notification message.

onlyWhenWindowUnfocused.description: Suppress notifications while the VS Code window or hosted dashboard is focused.

enableDiagnosticLogs.description: Enable verbose diagnostic logging for troubleshooting.
